intro: Apothecary Zinge is an alchemist and researcher of the Royal Apothecary Society stationed in the Apothecarium beneath the ruins of Lordaeron. Working in service to the Forsaken, she investigates biological specimens and coordinates research shipments across Horde territories.

p: Apothecary Zinge conducts experiments deep within the murky quarters of the Apothecarium in the Undercity. Like her colleagues under Master Apothecary Faranell, she seeks chemical and biological compounds that can further the goals of the Forsaken. Her research often connects her with field researchers and scouts stationed far beyond the boundaries of Tirisfal Glades, including exchanges with remote outposts in Kalimdor.

To refine her formulas and uncover new reagents, Zinge relies on couriers and adventurers to relay test materials across the seas. She maintains regular correspondence with colleagues such as Apothecary Helbrim stationed at the Crossroads in the Barrens, sending him toxic wolf heart samples from Silverpine Forest so he can study the effects of Lordaeron's toxins on the beasts of Kalimdor.
